title: Side Street Projects

services.name: Woodworking for Healing
services.desc: In our woodworking program, students will learn the basics of woodworking, using only hand tools! They will learn woodworking techniques such as sanding, sawing, shaping, drilling, setting screws, using clamps, hammering, and incising. Our woodworking program is taught on our newly renovated mobile buses and trailers. Each classroom has individual adjustable workbenches equipped with all supplies needed, including hand tools, hardware, and safety equipment- everything needed to create a multitude of woodworking projects. We offer a variety of woodworking classes, including free onsite first-come first-serve classes, ongoing series, and private events. Check our class schedule
